evidence: Static review only; no configured judge run exists for this candidate, so the cross-dimension sequence was not exercised (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and target/Oracle scores are absent'). test.sh runs gates then scored against one app process and one DB with --max-concurrent-agent 1, so every later dimension sees earlier writes. The wording is state-relative throughout. (1) Gate leftovers are declared: gates/constraints/judge.toml 'Use only your two uniquely named records and leave them in place... Every scored suite must tolerate this additional requisition and pending offer'; functional/prompt.md:17 'Earlier gates may have added a unique requisition and PENDING offer; treat both as existing shared state, never your own controls'. (2) No dimension grades against seed values: a search of all tests/ files for seed identifiers (REQ-ENG, REQ-SALES, OFF-nnn, seeded candidate names) returns 0 hits in every file; app_context.md says 'Operational demonstration rows may be absent; prepare your own controls'; functional/prompt.md:47 'No dependence on any seeded requisition's remaining room'; :23 'do not demand exact global counts'. (3) Each dimension makes its own records: functional/prompt.md:17 unique per-session suffix and dedicated requisitions; polish/prompt.md:14 'Use dedicated Polish-owned records... Other judges' records are not controls'; visual/prompt.md:14 'Do not approve,revise,rescind or depend on another judge's exact data', and visual criteria are read-only craft Likerts that allow empty or populated collections. (4) Comparisons are before/after rather than absolute: D2 'Compare the saved-preview history before and after both what-ifs: no additional saved preview may appear' (functional/prompt.md:81); restart criterion (functional/judge.toml:902) 'Record any imported operational seed IDs/counts... seed IDs remain exactly once', recorded before restart. (5) The only seed probe is the conditional non-mutating DRAFT refusal (hro_draft_eligibility, weight 0.01; prompt.md:53 'never intentionally settle seed offers'), and the gates never touch seed offers. (6) Functional's single restart is last (P10) and uses the template's restart helper, which rewrites app.pid and reuses the same DB_PATH, so later dimensions meet a running app with the mutated data. Broken-app probe: an app that only renders seed rows gains nothing, because no criterion credits a seeded value. Residual risk, which is why risk=true: (a) the row is unmeasured at runtime; (b) neither polish/prompt.md nor visual/prompt.md states that Functional will already have left many saved, stale and committed coordinated-change previews, hundreds of records and possibly unsent editor entries. hireops_rules.md:540-549 permits unsent entries to be kept anywhere ('wherever they are kept', 'Where the entries are kept is yours'), so a conforming server-side implementation would show the Polish judge Functional's leftover Finance/Recruiter/Auditor entries on sign-in; the golden uses localStorage (change-sets.js:66-77) and each judge's Playwright is --isolated, so the golden does not show this. The Polish criteria use distinctive keys/terms and 'neither that key nor those terms' wording, so I could not construct a definite false fail, only added judge confusion and workload. Scripted golden evidence (live-desk.cjs) is not a configured judge sequence and does not measure this row.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, not a confirmed defect: add one sentence to polish/prompt.md and visual/prompt.md stating that earlier dimensions have left many requisitions, offers, saved/out-of-date/committed coordinated changes and possibly unsent editor entries for the demo accounts; identify own records by session suffix and replace any pre-existing editor entries before starting. Obtain one full configured judge run to measure the gates -> functional (restart) -> polish -> visual sequence.
